notes.title: Spaceminers Patch Notes 0.28.001
notes.content:
Spaceminers 0.28.001 Patch Notes

 Prepare for an exciting new gameplay experience with the second Spaceminers: Gold Runner Tournament.
 We've implemented DLSS (Deep Learning Super Sampling) technology for improved graphics and performance.
 Based on player feedback, we've revamped the First Time User Experience to provide clearer instructions and make the initial training phase more accessible for all players.
 In Gold Runner the fireballs and boulders now spawn more efficiently for smoother gameplay, even on lower-performance PCs.
 In Gold Runner, boulder collisions have been adjusted to prevent players from evading them while on the same platform.
 Improved in-game nameplate style.
 Enhanced server stability.
 General stability improvements.
 Various minor bug fixes.

With DLSS implementation, it is a good idea to download the latest drivers from Nvidia to ensure optimal performance. For AMD users you can expect to see FidelityFX Super Resolution in the near future.
